metric_corrections_operand_check.name: metric_corrections_operand_check
metric_corrections_operand_check.value:
("metric_corrections"."kind" = 'retract' AND "metric_corrections"."exact_delta" IS NULL AND "metric_corrections"."replacement_value" IS NULL)
        OR ("metric_corrections"."kind" = 'replace' AND "metric_corrections"."exact_delta" IS NULL AND "metric_corrections"."replacement_value" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("metric_corrections"."kind" = 'adjust' AND "metric_corrections"."exact_delta" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_corrections"."replacement_value" IS NULL)

metric_readings_version_source_unique.name: metric_readings_version_source_unique
metric_readings_version_source_unique.where: "metric_readings"."definition_version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."source_event_id" IS NOT NULL

metric_readings_ratio_check.name: metric_readings_ratio_check
metric_readings_ratio_check.value: ("metric_readings"."numerator" IS NULL AND "metric_readings"."denominator" IS NULL) OR ("metric_readings"."numerator" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."denominator" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."denominator" > 0)

metric_readings_governed_provenance_chec.name: metric_readings_governed_provenance_check
metric_readings_governed_provenance_chec.value: "metric_readings"."definition_version_id" IS NULL OR ("metric_readings"."source_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."source_policy" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."exact_value" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."sample_count" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."attribution_quality" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."event_at" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."property_local_date" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."data_quality" IS NOT NULL AND "metric_readings"."retention_class" IS NOT NULL)

outbox_events_lease_expires_idx.name: outbox_events_lease_expires_idx
outbox_events_lease_expires_idx.where: "outbox_events"."published_at" IS NULL AND "outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL

properties_org_gbp_place_id_unique.name: properties_org_gbp_place_id_unique
properties_org_gbp_place_id_unique.where: gbp_place_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

replies_publication_reconcile_idx.name: replies_publication_reconcile_idx
replies_publication_reconcile_idx.where: publication_state = 'ambiguous' AND reconcile_due_at IS NOT NULL

staff_assignments_unique_direct.name: staff_assignments_unique_direct
staff_assignments_unique_direct.where: team_id IS NULL AND portal_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

staff_assignments_unique_portal.name: staff_assignments_unique_portal
staff_assignments_unique_portal.where: team_id IS NULL AND portal_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

staff_assignments_unique_team.name: staff_assignments_unique_team
staff_assignments_unique_team.where: team_id IS NOT NULL AND portal_id IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL

staff_assignments_unique_team_portal.name: staff_assignments_unique_team_portal
staff_assignments_unique_team_portal.where: team_id IS NOT NULL AND portal_id IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL
